post.description:
Apply a governance-approved parameter change to pool-hub service config.

The proposal_id must be provided — this endpoint is called by the
governance service after a proposal has passed and the timelock has
expired. The parameter change is validated against the allowed
parameters list.

400.description: Parameter '{change.parameter_name}' is not governance-controllable. Allowed: {list(GOVERNANCE_PARAMETERS.keys())} / Parameter '{change.parameter_name}' expects type {expected_type.__name__}, got {type(change.new_value).__name__} / Invalid parameter

409.description: Expected old value {change.old_value} does not match actual {old_value}

get.description: List parameters that can be changed via governance.

schema.title: Response List Governance Parameters V1 Parameters List Get

MatchCandidate.title: MatchCandidate
MatchCandidate.description:
A miner offered for a job.

``price`` is ``Decimal``, not ``float``: it is read from ``Miner.base_price``
(``Numeric(20, 8)``) in ``routers/match.py`` and written back to ``MatchResult.price``
(``Numeric(20, 8)``) in ``repositories/match_repository.py``. Declaring it ``float``
put a binary floating-point round trip in the middle of that path, losing precision at
the eighth decimal for no reason. ``score`` stays ``float`` — it is a ranking weight,
not money.

proposal_id.title: Proposal Id
proposal_id.description: Governance proposal ID that approved this change

target_service.title: Target Service
target_service.description: Service type to update (e.g. whisper, llm_inference)

parameter_name.title: Parameter Name
parameter_name.description: Name of the parameter to change

ParameterChangeRequest.title: ParameterChangeRequest
ParameterChangeRequest.description: Request body for applying a governance-approved parameter change.

ParameterChangeResponse.title: ParameterChangeResponse
ParameterChangeResponse.description: Response after applying a parameter change.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Raised as `HTTPException`; FastAPI serialises it under `detail`.
